finalShots.name: picker-open
finalShots.eval: (() => { const A = __notesDebug.useAgent.getState(); A.toggle(true); A.setPrefs({ model: 'gemma4:31b' }); __notesDebug.useAgent.setState({ hasKey: true }); setTimeout(() => document.querySelector('.mp-btn').click(), 100); return 1 })()

finalShots.name: picked-ultra-med
finalShots.eval: (() => { const card = [...document.querySelectorAll('.mp-opt')].find((c) => c.textContent.includes('Nemotron 3 Ultra') && c.textContent.includes('OpenRouter')); const pill = [...card.querySelectorAll('.mp-think-lv.pick')].find((p) => p.textContent.trim() === 'Med'); pill.click(); const s = __notesDebug.useAgent.getState(); return [s.prefs.model, JSON.stringify(s.prefs.thinkBy)] })()
